coverage.unrepresented: Zero-texel structures are retained in the inventory, not painted through the surface. This cross-model projection is approximate.

registration.method: skeletal and skin-ring thin-plate-spline correspondence; closest source skin and muscle/bone/connective envelope, 16-candidate triangle queries

rectusSheathPeel.method: Expose the actual front-facing rectus footprint beneath source oblique aponeurosis; no hand-authored outline

surfaceEligibility.scope: Conservative superficial display eligibility, not a complete anatomical visibility classifier. Excluded source surfaces remain zero-labelled occluders and keep their original inventory identities. Deep posterior forearm extensors retain their exposed distal portions. Uncertain registration stays neutral rather than expanding a deeper label.
